description: This Java class 'TraceUriGenerator' generates trace URIs based on request paths, with logic to shorten or categorize paths for tracing purposes. It implements a Function that maps a String path to a TraceInformation object, using regex matching and normalization. The class includes internal methods for pattern creation, path normalization, and trace information extraction.

classes.name: TraceUriGenerator
classes.description: Generates trace URIs based on request paths for tracing, focusing on minimizing request footprint and categorizing paths.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Generates TraceInformation from a given path string, normalizing and matching it against internal regex patterns.

methods.description: Singleton accessor that initializes the TraceUriGenerator with regex patterns for path parsing.
